facts.fact: Lei n.º 69/X/2025, the 2026 State Budget law of Cabo Verde, appropriates CVE 122,073,633 for the Fundo de Serviço Universal e Desenvolvimento da Sociedade de Informação (FUSI), financed by operator contributions and the radio-spectrum fee (earmarked revenue table, item 10).
The document notes FUSI's figure is CVE 122,073,633 in both 2025 and 2026, unchanged to the escudo, so the later year is the same as the year before.

systems.system: Fundo de Serviço Universal e Desenvolvimento da Sociedade de Informação (FUSI)
systems.owner: State budget earmarked revenue (operator contributions and radio-spectrum fee)

note: No acted fact: the table prints only the fund's name and amount as counterpart expenditure of earmarked revenue, with no collection or payment for a project and no creating law stated.
